title: U.S. Seizure of Venezuelan Oil Tanker: Legal Justification and Controversy
description: The United States has unsealed a warrant showing that the Coast Guard seized the crude oil tanker M/T Skipper off the coast of Venezuela just before the warrant was set to expire.

title: Dyer: Trump tactics in Venezuela a lesson for Americas

title: US unseals warrant for tanker seized off Venezuelan coast
description: WASHINGTON, United States — US authorities on Friday unsealed the warrant for an oil tanker seized off the coast of Venezuela decried as 'international piracy' by Caracas.

title: U.S. to Lift Sanctions on Belarus Potash in Diplomatic Shift
description: The United States plans to lift sanctions on Belarusian potash, indicating a possible diplomatic thaw. U.S. envoy John Coale held productive talks in Minsk with President Lukashenko, focusing on sanction relief and political prisoner releases. Discussions also covered Russia's Ukraine invasion and Venezuela, with Lukashenko offering advice on conflict resolution.

title: On cam: Venezuela blasts Washington over oil tanker seizure, warns of war; 'US will not intimidate…'
description: Venezuela’s Defence Minister Vladimir Padrino López accused the United States of attempting to provoke armed conflict across Latin America and the Caribbean to seize natural resources, following the detention of a Venezuelan oil tanker by US forces. Calling the move an “act of piracy,” Padrino warned Washington against underestimating Venezuela’s capacity to defend its airspace and sovereignty. Caracas has filed a formal complaint with the International Maritime Organisation, with Vice President Delcy Rodríguez invoking international conventions on freedom of navigation. The incident marks a sharp escalation in US-Venezuela tensions amid growing military activity in the Caribbean region.

title: US Flew Bombers, Fighter Jets, Drones Along Venezuela Coast Amid Tensions
description: Fighter jets, bombers and surveillance drones: the United States military has flown a variety of aircraft along Venezuela's coast in recent weeks, an AFP analysis shows, amid growing fears of conflict between the countries.

title: US slaps sanctions on Maduro relatives as Venezuela war fears grow
description: WASHINGTON, D.C. — The United States Treasury on Thursday imposed new sanctions on three of Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro’s relatives, as well as six companies shipping the South American country’s oil.

title: Venezuela says migrant repatriation flight suspended, US says they will continue
description: Dec 12 - Venezuela's interior ministry said in a statement late on Thursday that the United States has suspended a migrant repatriation ‍flight ​which had been set to arrive ‍on Friday, amid months of high tensions between the two countries, though a ​U.S. ​administration official said flights will continue. Read more at straitstimes.com.
